basis: Cardiomyopathy and red-cell spherocytosis define the syndrome.
Partial LCAT deficiency with defining corneal opacification; vascular disease and visceral enlargement occur in only 5-29%.
Disease of the vitreous humor; no extraocular involvement defines this umbrella.
Progressive CNS neuronal degeneration; rigidity and autonomic symptoms do not establish separate muscle or visceral damage.
Disorder of atrioventricular electrical conduction.
STAT3 immunodeficiency with eczema/abscesses; lung cysts 47/63 and bone disease 30-79%; dental/esophageal involvement and otitis omitted at four-axis cap.
Hereditary recurrent pregnancy loss affects reproduction; no covered organ damage is established.
IgD heavy-chain overproduction in a plasma-cell neoplasm; no established common extrahematologic organ damage.
Distal arthrogryposis with finger contractures, ulnar deviation and foot deformity.
Predominantly ovarian/testicular germ-cell tumor; pineal origin is rare; no metastatic organ established in at least 30% across the group.
Congenital colonic obstruction; accompanying intestinal abnormalities remain within the gastrointestinal axis.
Inflammation of a single peripheral nerve; an infectious or immune-mediated cause is not intrinsic to this umbrella.
Postinfectious brain inflammation, commonly immune-mediated; both CNS disease and infectious/immune mechanism define the concept.
Hereditary symmetric acral depigmentation; no established systemic organ involvement.
Malignant neoplasms of histiocytic blood-cell lineages; sites of extranodal infiltration vary across this umbrella.
Factor VIII deficiency causes bleeding; joint hemorrhage occurs in only 5-29%, and mucosal bleeding alone does not establish organ damage.
Severe MKD causes autoinflammation and neurodegeneration; cataracts/retinal abnormalities in 3/3; myopathy, anemia and hepatosplenic findings omitted at cap.
Epidermal nevus with defining vascular malformations, aneurysms and large-vessel arteriovenous shunts.
Isolated congenital cerebellar/posterior fossa malformation without hydrocephalus.
Skeletal dysplasia and ectopia lentis define the syndrome; pursed lips alone do not establish gastrointestinal disease.
Primary calvarial bone dysplasia; facial and periocular dysmorphism does not establish eye damage; development is normal.
Inherited febrile seizure disorder; fever as a trigger does not establish an infectious or immune disease.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with seizures, developmental delay and movement abnormalities; hypotonia alone does not establish primary muscle disease.
Hepatic glycogen metabolism disorder with common liver injury/fibrosis; muscle and neurodevelopmental abnormalities occur in fewer than 30%.
Supplied definition and parent include hypersensitivity pneumonitis/allergic airway disease; headache, irritation and transient eruptions do not establish other damage.
